title: Myricetin Suppresses Inflammatory Th17 Polarization to Mitigate Alzheimer's Disease Pathogenesis.
authors: Li, Yufei; Sun, Ao; Han, Jingjing; Hong, Rui; Cao, Cong; Zhou, Aihua; Fan, Zhengxiang; Zhang, Linlin; Qu, Xuebin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究杨梅素通过抑制转录因子RORgammat与IL-17启动子结合来缓解阿尔茨海默病，涉及蛋白-DNA互作（RORgammat-DNA）及分子对接/动力学模拟，但核心是药物抑制与疾病治疗，非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: AIMS: This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic potential of myricetin, a natural flavonoid, in Alzheimer's disease (AD) by targeting Th17 cell-mediated neuroinflammation through inhibition of the transcription factor RORgammat. METHODS: Virtual screening of 47,963 compounds identified myricetin as a potential RORgammat inhibitor, validated by molecular docking and dynamics simulations. In vivo, 3xTg-AD mice were treated with myricetin (50 mg/kg/day) for 8.5 weeks, followed by behavioral tests (novel object recognition, Morris water maze) and pathological analyses (HE/Nissl staining, immunohistochemistry, Western blot). In vitro, Th17 polarization assays and mechanistic studies (ChIP, EMSA, MST) were performed to elucidate myricetin's action on RORgammat-IL-17 signaling. RESULTS: Myricetin exhibited stable binding to RORgammat (Kd = 6.40 muM), suppressing Th17 polarization and IL-17 production. In AD mice, myricetin improved cognitive function, reduced neuronal damage, decreased Abeta plaques and phosphorylated tau levels, and attenuated microglial activation. Mechanistically, myricetin blocked RORgammat recruitment to the IL17 promoter, downregulating IL-17 transcription. CONCLUSION: Myricetin ameliorates AD pathology by inhibiting RORgammat-driven Th17 polarization, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic agent for AD.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨天然黄酮类化合物杨梅素（myricetin）通过抑制转录因子RORgammat靶向Th17细胞介导的神经炎症，从而治疗阿尔茨海默病（AD）的潜力。方法：对47,963种化合物进行虚拟筛选，鉴定杨梅素为潜在的RORgammat抑制剂，并通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟进行验证。体内实验中，3xTg-AD小鼠接受杨梅素治疗（50 mg/kg/天）8.5周，随后进行行为学测试（新物体识别、Morris水迷宫）和病理学分析（HE/Nissl染色、免疫组织化学、Western blot）。体外实验中，进行Th17极化实验和机制研究（ChIP、EMSA、MST），以阐明杨梅素对RORgammat-IL-17信号通路的作用。结果：杨梅素与RORgammat表现出稳定结合（Kd = 6.40 μM），抑制Th17极化和IL-17产生。在AD小鼠中，杨梅素改善了认知功能，减少了神经元损伤，降低了Aβ斑块和磷酸化tau蛋白水平，并减弱了小胶质细胞活化。机制上，杨梅素阻断RORgammat向IL17启动子的募集，下调IL-17转录。结论：杨梅素通过抑制RORgammat驱动的Th17极化改善AD病理，凸显其作为AD治疗药物的潜力。
